headline: Mohamed Mansour to Build $150 Million Electric Vehicle Plant in Egypt
summary: Billionaire Mohamed Mansour plans to complete a $150 million electric vehicle manufacturing facility in 6th of October City by early 2027, supporting Egypt's goal to become a regional automotive hub.
why: Large-scale industrial investments in the EV sector reflect regional efforts to diversify manufacturing bases and transition toward sustainable energy transport.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: New manufacturing capacity supports growth in the local automotive sector.
